# Draft:Action Of King

Action Of King is an Indian Hindi-language romance musical action suspense thriller war spy comedy film. The film stars Sunny Deol in titular role alongside his son Karan Deol (in his theatrical debut),  Karishma Kapoor, Akshay Kumar, Sunil Shetty, Preity Zinta, Shilpa Shetty, Tiger Shroff in lead roles with Anil Kapoor, Salman Khan, Shah Rukh Khan, Hrithik Roshan, Dino Morea, Aftab Shivdasani, Manisha Koirala, Tusshar Kapoor, Emraan Hashmi, Kajol Devgn, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, Ali Zafar, Ameesha Patel, Kareena Kapoor Khan, Mehwish Hayat, Sarwat Gillani, Iman Ali, Ayesha Omar, Atif Aslam, Dia Mirza, Isha Koppikar, Shreyas Talpade, Kunal Khemu, Daler Mehndi, Mika Singh, Alishka Varde, Sugandha Garg, Rahul Dev and Rani Mukerji in supporting roles.
